biological_replicate: Trichoderma harzianum strain LPSc 1503 from INBIOTEC (Mar del Plata, Argentina)
experimental_design: Comparison of secretome between culture media (CM) and aqueous filtrate (AF)
Different profiles of proteins secreted by the fungus grown in the culture media or in the aqueous filtrate were observed through SDS‒PAGE and LC‒MS/MS analysis
factor_value: supernatants of culture media (CM) in which T. harzianum was grown for 5 days, and the aqueous filtrate (AF) in which the fungal mycelia was submerged for 72 h
number_of_biological_replicates: All the experiments were carried out in duplicates.
number_of_samples: All the experiments were carried out in duplicates.
